name: Software Z-buffer Brick Projection
definition: A software-based method to determine rays-volume intersection regions by projecting a single brick per viewing direction to create a z-buffer footprint template, avoiding OpenGL off-screen rendering and glReadPixels overhead.
summary: Software Z-buffer Brick Projection is a CPU-based volume rendering method that projects a single representative brick to create a reusable z-buffer template, avoiding GPU memory constraints and glReadPixels overhead.
